title: A New Spirit
text: "Yeah. I don't really know why, but I just ended up coming all the way down here on my own."
"Huh... Well, I'd heard stories about this, but are you still chasing after Filo-chan?"
"Still"? This spirit sounds like she knows who I am, too. Just like the spirit next to her—have I met her somewhere before?
“Exactly. Right now, while I’m trying to recreate Filo, she’s causing all sorts of trouble. I did tell her to do whatever she wanted, though.”
“I see… Sounds just like her. Well, personally, I’d prefer she tone down the chaos a bit.”
But… what is it? I get the feeling there’s a bit of a sting to those words. It reminds me of someone.

“Ah, I suppose I should introduce myself? She’s… a girl who’ll eventually become a defensive-type spirit—a Holy Weapon spirit for things like clothing, armor, and shields. Specifically, she’ll inhabit the armor that Naofumi-kun wore in the original world. Oh, and right now, she’s also supporting the hammer’s Vassal Weapons in this branching world. Eventually, she’ll become armor herself.”
“Right. I have a history with her, and we get along well, after all.”
“Is that Father’s armor? So, in the years to come, Father’s armor will become a holy weapon, then?”
It was indeed an amazing suit of armor with truly impressive performance, so that’s certainly a possibility.
“Yes. Once she’s gotten used to it to a certain extent, she’ll set out on a journey and serve as a pillar in her assigned world.”
“I see.”
I don’t fully understand her role as a spirit, but it seems she’s doing it as part of her job.
“……The Spear Spirit says I can do as I please, but if I don’t keep it in check… I might get bludgeoned or stabbed to death somewhere, right?”
The spirit in front of me said something that sent a chill down my spine. It brought back a memory of when my Big Sister hit me with a hammer.
“Plus, I was practically a wreck from the shock of making Filo-chan sick……”
“Eek…”
I remembered a little of what happened back then.
“Hey, Spear Spirit. Don’t go spreading rumors about me.”
“I’m not exactly spreading rumors—I can just sense things because I’m a spirit. I do know a bit about the situation here, after all. After all, she was close to Naofumi-kun.”
“What did you say?”
Close to my Father? So that means…
“So that means… she’s your Big Sister?”
I wonder if half of her Big Sister became a spirit after she died?
“No, that’s not it. Would Raphtalia-san really call Filo-chan by her first name?”
“She’s not a spirit, is she?”
“Hmm… maybe her Big Sister’s Big Sister, or the Panda?”
“That’s not it either. We were indebted to Sadeena-san, but our relationship with Larsazusa-san was just about entrusting her with merchandise.”
“Well… the difficulty level is pretty high, isn’t it? Here’s a hint: her uncle is there too. She’s a spirit-kind who died around the same time and became half-spirit.”
The spirit—the one who mentioned something about a “hammer spirit” or something like that—is bobbing up and down.
“That brings back memories… Man, I didn’t understand that until I died of old age, so I was really surprised.”
“When you’re a spirit-kind, you have to grow quite a bit in various ways before your spirit side can hold strong power.”
Hmm… Is my uncle there? A spirit with my uncle…
“That spirit over there is Trash, and you’re a Tiger Girl, aren’t you!”

My uncle must have been Trash to the Tiger Girl. And I heard that the Tiger Girl is supporting her Father as a spirit, and I seem to remember her appearing in my dreams, so there’s no doubt about it. I mean, you Trash! You’ve even become a spirit! Just how infatuated is the Staff Spirit with you, anyway? I bet she fused with your soul even after your death to turn you into a spirit.
“That’s not it. To miss the mark even after I’ve given you this many hints—you really are the Spear Hero, aren’t you? It seems you haven’t learned a thing.”
“How should I put this… you haven’t changed a bit. I’m glad to see you’re doing well.”
Is that not the case?
“You should be able to figure it out if you just look for that acquaintance with relatives in the village you know—yet you still get it wrong. Is that cluelessness, or just plain stupidity…?”
“Shut up! Just tell me already!”
“Well, the fact that you initially mistook her for Raphtalia was, in a way, pretty close to the right answer, wasn’t it?”

And with that, the Spear Spirit remained coy and refused to give me the answer. "Just tell me already!" I said, staring intently at the light emanating from the two spirits, and faintly made out the silhouette of some kind of animal. This figure is...?
"Well... Shield Hero, Naofumi-sama used to say I looked like a young Raphtalia and was cute..."
“I think she looks a lot like little Raphtalia-chan from this angle, too. Didn’t she have more charm when she was alive?”

“Mind your own business. I can’t stay a child forever, can I? I’m taking on a position of responsibility now… Still, I’d like to go back to Naofumi-sama and talk with him like we used to. But that’s going to be tough.”
It looked as if two moles were taking shape.
“If you act too cute, won’t Raphtalia-chan get jealous and make things difficult for you? You once begged for your life and caused Raphtalia-chan a lot of trouble, didn’t you?”

“Ugh… let’s change the subject. In this loop… it seems I’ve been forgotten. Still, I’m glad Raphtalia-san and the others were saved. Even among countless possibilities, it’s happier to be saved, after all.”
Ah! That’s right. I’d completely forgotten that the slave hunters were coming to the moles’ place. So, does that mean these two spirits are actually moles!?
“Moles, you say!?”

“It’s so typical of you to only realize that now, after we’ve talked this far. Yes, they’re a spirit race that exists in this world. After learning all sorts of things from you guys and living out their lives, half of them turned into spirits.”

“I lived my life as a spirit race just like this, too,” the spear spirit is blabbering on about something. Guh… I do remember my Father saying that the Moles have a cute side, like a Big Sister from the past. This is an incredibly awkward situation. It’s almost like when my Big Sister found out I was stuck in a loop, didn’t help me, and then I ran into her while I was still looping.
“You’re looking kind of troubled.”
“Well, maybe you’re just feeling that way because you’re not too fond of Raphtalia-chan? Above all, it’s awkward, isn’t it? You’ve completely forgotten to save her.”
“I do have something I want to say, though.”

By the way, both the mole and that uncle were using claws and hammers. I wonder if he’ll pull a hammer out of nowhere to punish me and try to bludgeon me to death? Since I have memories of getting beaten to a pulp by Big Sister, I might need to be careful with my response.
“Thanks to the loop’s causality affecting me as well, my status as a spirit has actually risen, so I’m not really angry. Besides, I might even get to meet someone from the past.”

Hmm… It seems I’ve managed to escape with my life. If, out of spite, they remove whatever Ark put in place to prevent me from looping, send me back to my original Japan, and make me forget everything, that would be a real pain. Since she’s a spirit, I have a feeling she could do that.
“To really ramp up the awkwardness here, maybe I should switch places with her as the Spear Spirit for a while? You were hoping for a change, right?”
The Spear Spirit seized the moment to taunt me.
“No way!”
A mole with a ‘Big Sister’ vibe residing in my spear? That’s incredibly awkward. I’d be in big trouble if she ratted me out and my Big Sister came to beat me to a pulp.
“It’s not going to work because of compatibility issues. You weren’t planning on doing that anyway, were you? I get that you want to be mean, but please take it easy.”

The Mole came to my rescue with a wry smile. After all, this is a factor where, if I upset her, I have no idea what she might do. Maybe I need to be a little more considerate of the Mole. I do have to admit, I’m a bit envious that my Father used to dote on her.
